CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetException

When a method of a Java object throws an exception, KoldFusion raises an error of type Object whose CFCATCH.Message is just the exception's class name. GetException gives you the exception object itself, so you can call its methods (getMessage(), or the extra methods of your own exception classes).

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetException(object)

Parameters

object
A Java object created with CFOBJECT or CreateObject, on which a method has thrown an exception.

Returns

The exception, as a Java object. Each successful method call on the object clears it; then GetException returns an empty string.

Usage

GetException arrived with ColdFusion 5; KoldFusion 4.5 has it already.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFTRY>
  <CFSET Num = CreateObject("JAVA", "java.lang.Integer")>
  <CFTRY>
    <CFSET N = Num.parseInt("forty-two")>
    <CFCATCH TYPE="Object">
      <CFSET Ex = GetException(Num)>
      <CFOUTPUT>
      <P>CFCATCH.Message: <B>#CFCATCH.Message#</B><BR>
      Ex.getMessage(): <B>#Ex.getMessage()#</B><BR>
      Ex.getClass().getName(): <B>#Ex.getClass().getName()#</B></P>
      </CFOUTPUT>
    </CFCATCH>
  </CFTRY>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Object">
    <CFOUTPUT><P>No Java Virtual Machine: <I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I></P></CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
